# Taxonomy

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/catalog.js from taxonomy.yaml. Edit taxonomy.yaml, then run `npm run build`. -->

Every template lives at `templates/<jurisdiction>/<category>/<subcategory>/<file>.md`. This page lists every allowed value. To propose a new category or subcategory, open a pull request that edits `taxonomy.yaml`.

## Jurisdictions

| Folder | Jurisdiction | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `us/` | United States | Federal / state-neutral templates. State-specific templates use US-XX (ISO 3166-2), e.g. US-CA, US-NY, US-TX. |
| `ca/` | Canada | Federal / province-neutral templates. Province-specific templates use CA-XX, e.g. CA-ON, CA-BC, CA-QC. |
| `gb/` | United Kingdom | GB-ENG, GB-SCT, GB-WLS, GB-NIR for nation-specific templates. |
| `ie/` | Ireland |  |
| `au/` | Australia | AU-NSW, AU-VIC etc. for state-specific templates. |
| `nz/` | New Zealand |  |
| `eu/` | European Union | EU-wide instruments only (e.g. GDPR DPAs, SCCs). Member-state templates go under their own country. |
| `in/` | India |  |
| `sg/` | Singapore |  |
| `intl/` | International / jurisdiction-neutral | Templates drafted to work anywhere, or cross-border instruments with no single governing jurisdiction. |

## Categories and subcategories

### Employment — `employment/`

Contracts and documents governing the relationship between an employer and an employee (not contractors).

| Subcategory | What goes here |
| --- | --- |
| `offer-letters/` | Offer letters and letters of employment that form or precede an employment contract. |
| `employment-agreements/` | General employment agreements for full-time, part-time, hourly and salaried staff. |
| `executive/` | Agreements for C-suite, senior executives and key-person roles (change-of-control, golden parachute, board service). |
| `fixed-term-and-temporary/` | Fixed-term, seasonal, casual, zero-hours and temporary engagements. |
| `internships-and-apprenticeships/` | Internship, co-op, apprenticeship and training agreements. |
| `remote-and-hybrid-work/` | Remote work agreements, hybrid policies and home-office arrangements. |
| `restrictive-covenants/` | Standalone non-compete, non-solicitation, no-hire and garden-leave agreements. |
| `confidentiality-and-ip/` | Employee confidentiality, invention assignment and proprietary information agreements. |
| `compensation-and-benefits/` | Bonus plans, commission plans, equity grant letters, retention and sign-on agreements. |
| `separation-and-termination/` | Severance, separation, termination letters, releases, resignation and retirement documents. |
| `policies-and-handbooks/` | Employee handbooks and standalone workplace policies (leave, conduct, anti-harassment, expenses). |
| `workplace-notices-and-forms/` | Warning letters, performance improvement plans, accommodation requests, HR forms. |
| `collective-and-union/` | Collective agreements, union recognition and related instruments. |

### Contractors & Consultants — `contractors/`

Engagements with independent contractors, consultants, freelancers and agencies, where no employment relationship is intended.

| Subcategory | What goes here |
| --- | --- |
| `independent-contractor/` | General independent contractor agreements. |
| `consulting/` | Consulting and advisory agreements, including fractional executives and advisors. |
| `statement-of-work/` | Statements of work and work orders that attach to a master agreement. |
| `freelance-and-creative/` | Freelance, creative services, design, writing and photography engagements. |
| `staffing-and-recruitment/` | Staffing agency, recruitment and placement agreements. |

### Confidentiality — `confidentiality/`

Standalone non-disclosure and confidentiality instruments between businesses or individuals.

| Subcategory | What goes here |
| --- | --- |
| `mutual-nda/` | Mutual / bilateral non-disclosure agreements. |
| `unilateral-nda/` | One-way non-disclosure agreements. |
| `due-diligence-and-data-room/` | Confidentiality agreements for transactions, investor diligence and data rooms. |

### Commercial — `commercial/`

Business-to-business agreements for buying and selling goods and services.

| Subcategory | What goes here |
| --- | --- |
| `master-services/` | Master services agreements and general services agreements. |
| `sale-of-goods/` | Sale, supply and purchase of goods. |
| `supply-and-procurement/` | Supply chain, procurement and vendor agreements. |
| `distribution-and-reseller/` | Distribution, reseller, dealer and channel partner agreements. |
| `agency-and-referral/` | Sales agency, referral and finder's fee agreements. |
| `franchise/` | Franchise and master franchise agreements. |
| `terms-and-conditions/` | Standard terms of sale, terms of purchase and purchase-order terms. |
| `subscription-and-membership/` | Subscription, membership and recurring-service agreements. |

### Technology — `technology/`

Software, SaaS, IT services and online platform agreements.

| Subcategory | What goes here |
| --- | --- |
| `saas/` | Software-as-a-service subscription agreements and order forms. |
| `software-license/` | On-premise and perpetual software licence agreements. |

| `development-services/` | Software, web and app development agreements. |
| `hosting-and-cloud/` | Hosting, cloud infrastructure and service-level agreements. |
| `api-terms/` | API and developer terms. |

### Intellectual Property — `intellectual-property/`

| Subcategory | What goes here |
| --- | --- |
| `assignment/` | IP assignment and transfer agreements. |
| `licensing/` | General IP licence agreements (in-bound and out-bound). |
| `trademark/` | Trademark licence, coexistence and consent agreements. |
| `copyright-and-content/` | Copyright licences, content licences and publishing agreements. |
| `patent/` | Patent licence, assignment and cross-licence agreements. |

| --- | --- |
| `privacy-policy/` | Website, app and customer privacy policies and notices. |

| `cookie-policy/` | Cookie and tracking policies. |
| `website-terms/` | Website and app terms of use / terms of service. |
| `acceptable-use/` | Acceptable-use and community guidelines. |

| Subcategory | What goes here |

### Clause Library — `clauses/`

Standalone clauses to insert into other documents. Files here are type "clause".

| Subcategory | What goes here |
| --- | --- |
| `boilerplate/` | Entire agreement, notices, assignment, counterparts, severability, governing law. |
| `risk-allocation/` | Indemnity, limitation of liability, insurance, warranties, force majeure. |
| `payment/` | Payment terms, late fees, taxes, expenses, set-off. |
| `termination/` | Term, renewal, termination for cause/convenience, survival. |
| `definitions/` | Reusable definition blocks. |

## Document types

| `type` | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `agreement` | A bilateral or multilateral contract signed by all parties. |
| `letter` | A letter-form instrument (offer letter, termination letter, demand letter). |
| `policy` | A unilateral company policy or handbook section. |
| `notice` | A formal notice served by one party on another. |
| `form` | A fill-in form, application or questionnaire. |
| `clause` | A standalone clause or short block of clauses for insertion into another document. |
| `checklist` | A drafting, review or closing checklist (not itself a contract). |
| `schedule` | A schedule, exhibit, annex or statement of work that attaches to a parent agreement. |

## Statuses

| `status` | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `draft` | Added to the library but not yet reviewed by a lawyer or senior reviewer. |
| `reviewed` | Reviewed for structure, completeness and obvious legal issues in its jurisdiction. |
| `approved` | Reviewed and signed off as safe to recommend as a starting point. |
| `deprecated` | Kept for reference only. Superseded or no longer reliable; do not recommend. |

## Accepted licences

| `license` | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `CC0-1.0` | Creative Commons Zero (public-domain dedication) |
| `CC-BY-4.0` | Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (attribution required; goHeather's own drafts use this) |
| `MIT` | MIT License |
| `Apache-2.0` | Apache License 2.0 |
| `Public-Domain` | US federal government work or other work in the public domain with no licence |
| `Permission-Granted` | Author gave goHeather written permission to redistribute and adapt (source.url and source.notes must link to or quote the permission) |
